component: Calendar invitations localization resource and migration mapping

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The invitations document loads calendar/calendar-invitations-dialog.ftl and marks the title/updating/empty states with Fluent IDs. The custom item fragment marks Accept and Decline buttons with their own IDs and removes its old DTD argument. Fluent keeps title/status message values separate from the buttons’ .label attributes. The migration script requests copies of five old DTD values into those roles, while the DTD file and jar entry are removed. Check both document and dynamic-template consumers during this kind of migration. No locale migration, dialog or live translation test ran.
title: Invitation Fluent migration covers document text and dynamically created buttons
